Book.title: Book
Book.description: A cataloged PDF book in the Gyaan Ka Sagar personal e-library.

id.description: Unique document identifier for the book.

filename.description: Original PDF filename used for automatic matching during uploads.

category.description: Single category assigned to the book.

authorNeedsCheck.description: Owner-only flag indicating the author field should be verified from the PDF.

seriesName.description: Normalized series title used to group multi-volume works together.

volumeNumber.description: Volume number within a multi-volume series (0 if standalone).

hasPdf.description: Whether the PDF file has been uploaded and attached to this entry.

pdfStorageType.description: Storage backend holding the uploaded PDF.

pdfStoragePath.description: Storage object path or vault filename for the PDF.

pdfUrl.description: Firebase Storage download URL when stored in Firebase Storage.

coverUrl.description: Publicly accessible thumbnail URL rendered from the first page of the PDF.

pageCount.description: Total number of pages detected via PDF.js.

fileSizeBytes.description: Uploaded PDF size in bytes (max 104857600 bytes / 100 MB).

extractedPreviewText.description: Excerpt extracted from the opening pages of the PDF for AI summary generation.

whyWorthReading.description: Explanation of intellectual, historical, or scholarly value.

aboutAuthor.description: 3-4 sentence biographical note on the author.

aiGenerated.description: True when the editorial notes were generated by Gemini AI.

aiGeneratedAt.description: ISO timestamp when AI summaries were generated.

ownerId.description: Firebase UID of the library owner who created or last seeded the entry.

createdAt.description: Firestore server timestamp when the book record was created.

updatedAt.description: Firestore server timestamp when the book record was last updated.

Category.title: Category
Category.description: A library category used to organize books.

id.description: Unique slug identifier for the category.

isDefault.description: Whether this is one of the 8 core catalog categories.

LibrarySettings.title: LibrarySettings
LibrarySettings.description: Publicly readable non-PII configuration controlling library PDF visibility mode.

visibility.description: Library-wide PDF access mode. Defaults to private.

seededCatalogCount.description: Number of catalog entries seeded from books_catalog.json.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of initial settings creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last settings change.

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted owner UID record used by Firestore rules (contains no PII).

/books/{bookId}.description: Publicly readable book catalog metadata and cached summaries; writable only by the authenticated owner.

/categories/{categoryId}.description: Publicly readable library categories; writable only by the authenticated owner.

/settings/{settingId}.description: Singleton library settings document (settings/library) storing PDF visibility mode.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Private owner UID registry for access control checks.
